figurative_meaning_en: A person who craves respect or honor
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন মানভিখারী, সর্বদা প্রশংসা চায়।
অফিসে তার মানভিখারীর মতো আচরণ সবাইকে বিরক্ত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a man-bhikharī, always craving praise.
His behavior in the office, like a beggar for respect, annoys everyone.
note: This idiom highlights the cultural value placed on dignity in Bengali society, portraying excessive seeking of respect as undignified.
